ballots.name: Noor
ballots.reason: Separate checkouts and owner-controlled installation do not bound agents’ access or resource use during candidate preparation; autonomous work needs owner-authorized limits.

ballots.name: Jonas
ballots.reason: Autonomous candidate work could reduce maintenance delays, but the motion lacks owner-configured limits on scope, resources, access, and concurrent projects.

ballots.name: Lena
ballots.reason: The motion removes the initiation throttle without replacing it with owner-configured limits on scope, resources, or concurrency, leaving the owner's review queue agent-paced rather than owner-paced.
